dedupe_keys.name: derris insurer and city partnership for sme climate adaptation in turin italy

description: A Climate-ADAPT case study of an insurer helping small firms plan for climate risks. It says the LIFE DERRIS project (2015-2018) set up a public-private partnership of the City of Turin, the insurer Unipol and 32 small and medium enterprises in six industrial and manufacturing areas; 28 firms completed Company Adaptation Action Plans with 565 actions, and the city drafted an Integrated District Adaptation Plan. The online CRAM tool, based on flood zones and a questionnaire, was then used by 128 firms in ten more cities; flooding (about 25 per cent of measures) and heavy rain (18 per cent) were the main hazards, and measures included flood barriers, raised floors and disaster recovery plans. It notes that 90 per cent of Italian businesses halted for over a week by climate events went bankrupt within a year. The page is free to read. Coverage is Turin and other Italian cities. Caveats: the licence is the EEA reuse policy, and there are no loss figures per firm. For simulation it shows how business interruption from floods can be assessed firm by firm. A related catalogue record is the CFPB flood risk to mortgages case study.
